'''August 2000 Normal tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Normal, Illinois on 3 August 2000. It is known from David Marincic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1101">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-normal-il-8-3-00d1101/ normal-il-8-3-00], DeckTech (David "Wedge659" Marincic, 7 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-normal-il-8-3-00d1101/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Normal, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
